description: Soccer transfers from player profiles: player, from and to team, date, season, window (summer, winter, other by the date), type (transfer, loan, loan_return, free, promoted, swap, unknown) and fee_eur where the feed gives an amount (often null: say the fee is not known, never 0). Filter by league (moves in or out of its current teams), team (direction in or out), season and window; sort by fee for the biggest moves. Moves dated after today (mostly planned loan ends) are left out; planned true returns only those. Profiles are re-read every 30 days, so the latest moves can be missing.

direction.description: with team_id: in or out (default both)

league_id.description: moves in or out of this league's current teams

planned.description: true: only agreed moves dated after today (mostly loan ends); default: moves up to today

sort.description: date (default, latest first) or fee (highest first)

window.description: summer (1 June-5 September), winter (1 January-3 February) or other

name: get_transfers
